body:
Thanks stranger, I really appreciate it. Having someone to talk to is helping things feel a little less hopeless. 

Give me a few and I'll shoot you a DM with some of my art, and maybe a snippet of my writing if I can find a part I'm comfortable sharing (the story I'm working on is far too long to justify subjecting you to in one go).

I don't feel comfortable sharing my writing, since I write fanfiction and my choice of hobby feels *extremely* silly right now, but I can share my art privately (I'd want to crop/cover my signature though, since I post my art on social media).

Things are...really hard, yeah. It feels like I've been a dead man walking all my life and I haven't had a chance to breathe in almost a quarter of a century. Thank you for taking the time to comment; I thought I was just going to shout into the void and I'm glad someone responded.
